controls.name: identity / pass-through
controls.role: Exact baseline for every candidate; a NELE candidate must beat identity on a valid listener-side comparison without an output-power confound.

controls.name: target-speech RMS restoration before mixing
controls.role: Partial output-power control: each candidate's speech RMS is restored to the unprocessed speech RMS before the masker is added; not a full output-power-constraint protocol.

controls.name: energy-matched scalar gain and +1 dB level confound
controls.role: Separates spectral redistribution from level; the deliberate level confound verifies that the fixture detects output-power changes.

controls.name: fixed six-band spectral tilt
controls.role: Classic finalist in the local screen; aggregate-mean leader but its utterance-clustered ESTOI interval crosses zero.

controls.name: DRC alone and shaping plus DRC
controls.role: Separates dynamic-range compression from spectral shaping; DRC alone has the only local interval above zero versus identity, but only 12 clusters and no listener benefit.

controls.name: listener-side masker at -5, 0 and +5 dB SNR/TMR
controls.role: Mixes the masker after target processing; keeps the near-end masking condition explicit and stratified.

controls.name: STOI/ESTOI predicted-score separation
controls.role: Keeps objective predictors out of human listening, listening-effort and intelligibility-benefit claims.

controls.name: headroom, peak guard and nonfinite controls
controls.role: Records unity-peak exceedances and numerical failure behavior; a headroom waiver is not a quality pass.

controls.name: missing, invalid, short and nonfinite scorer controls
controls.role: Missing or invalid items are blocked, not scored; no missing result may qualify a candidate.
